fluff.overview: Galatea's dune buggies and cross-country bikes have long seen field modifications and use by mercenary forces passing through the Hiring Hall world. When a Combine-born motorized infantry regiment was assigned to Galatea after the founding of the Republic, its soldiers quickly adopted these highly flexible local vehicles, driving new standardized models from Galatean manufacturers. Armed with auto rifles supplemented by semi-portable machine guns, the Galatean Support Wheels combine the speed of motorized transport with enough organic firepower to hold ground against light opposition. The GSW are considered the best example of RAF motorized infantry, a formation born from practical adaptation rather than central procurement.
